_about: Binary prompts the phone shows (left/right half, or keys 1/2). Each option nudges OCEAN traits. Trait nudges are design choices loosely based on taste research (Openness and abstract/dark art), not validated items. The 'counterpart' field names the Cambridge Analytica era move each prompt restages.

prompts.counterpart: the personality quiz as bait: a harmless choice that is really a measurement
a 'like' on a page: taste as a proxy for personality
self-report items in the myPersonality app
abstract versus representational art preference, a known Openness marker

prompts.ask: tell me a secret (type it) or keep it
prompts.counterpart: disclosure as data: what you volunteer is the most valuable signal. Only the length is kept, never the text.
